verses.text: A Song. A Psalm of David. My heart being firm, O God, I will sing and make music, even with my glory!

segments.text: A Song. A Psalm of David. My heart being firm, O God, I will sing and make music, even with my glory!

verses.text: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn!

segments.text: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn!

verses.text: I will praise You among the peoples, O YHWH, and I will sing praises to You among the nations.

segments.text: I will praise You among the peoples, O YHWH, and I will sing praises to You among the nations.

verses.text: For great over the heavens [is] Your loving devotion, and up to the clouds [is] Your faithfulness.

segments.text: For great over the heavens [is] Your loving devotion, and up to the clouds [is] Your faithfulness.

verses.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God, and over all the earth Your glory!

segments.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God, and over all the earth Your glory!

verses.text: That Your beloved may be delivered, save [with] Your right hand, and answer me!

segments.text: That Your beloved may be delivered, save [with] Your right hand, and answer me!

verses.text: God has spoken from His holy place: “I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Succoth.

segments.text: God has spoken from His holy place: “I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and measure out the Valley of Succoth.

verses.text: Unto Me [is] Gilead, unto Me [is] Manasseh; and Ephraim [is] the strength of My head, Judah [is] My scepter.

segments.text: Unto Me [is] Gilead, unto Me [is] Manasseh; and Ephraim [is] the strength of My head, Judah [is] My scepter.

verses.text: Moab [is] the basin of My washing; upon Edom I will cast My sandal; over Philistia I will shout in triumph.”

segments.text: Moab [is] the basin of My washing; upon Edom I will cast My sandal; over Philistia I will shout in triumph.”

verses.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?

segments.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me as far as Edom?

verses.text: Have You not, O God, cast us off? And will You no longer go forth, O God, with our armies?

segments.text: Have You not, O God, cast us off? And will You no longer go forth, O God, with our armies?

verses.text: May You give to us help from adversity, and the salvation of man [is] emptiness.

segments.text: May You give to us help from adversity, and the salvation of man [is] emptiness.

verses.text: With God we will act [in] strength, and He will trample our adversaries.

segments.text: With God we will act [in] strength, and He will trample our adversaries.
